comparison.objective: Inspect three covered cases and return an instrument module to the empty one, reseating the lids.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid manipulation, wrist-camera inspection, and collision-free module placement; no intentional fracture or fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Module enters the empty case and all three lids are reseated; entering an occupied case irreversibly yields zero. Pose thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Its central outcome is visually informed storage in an unoccupied receptacle, not insert tang removal.
